about.title: About
about.headline: Technology Leader From Enterprise Engineering to Startup Building
about.intro: I am a technology leader and hands-on software architect with experience spanning Scientific IT, Healthcare, High-Scale Web Platforms, Industrial IoT, Pharma Manufacturing, AI, and Startup Product Development.
about.journey: My career has evolved from building software for DNA diagnostic and scientific instruments, to engineering healthcare and pharmacy platforms, to architecting web ecosystems supporting 50,000+ automotive dealership websites, and now leading technology and operations while transforming industrial machinery into connected, data-driven systems.
about.startup: Alongside my enterprise experience, I continue to build startup-style technology products focused on solving real-world business and operational problems.
about.journeyHeading: Scientific IT → Healthcare → Massive Web Scale → Industrial IoT → Leadership
about.flow: Physical Machinery → Sensors → Data → Cloud → Analytics → React Dashboards → Business Decisions
about.leadership: Leading a 40+ person organization across engineering, manufacturing, and business operations—aligning technical strategy, execution priorities, and digital transformation to drive measurable operational growth.
about.transformation: Modernizing traditional operational workflows and connecting physical manufacturing environments with modern software platforms.
